pairs.question: Cuius est haec puella?
pairs.answer: Haec est Moabitis quae venit cum Noemi de regione moabitide.
pairs.derivation: Booz asks the servant (v.5 'dixitque Booz iuveni qui messoribus praeerat cuius est haec puella'); dropped the speech tag. Answer is the servant's reply (v.6 'qui respondit haec est Moabitis...'); dropped 'qui respondit'. Stopped at end of v.6; v.7 ('et rogavit ut spicas colligeret...') is added narration about her conduct, not part of the spoken reply.

pairs.question: Unde mihi hoc ut invenirem gratiam ante oculos tuos et nosse me dignareris peregrinam mulierem?
pairs.answer: Nuntiata sunt mihi omnia quae feceris socrui tuae post mortem viri tui et quod dereliqueris parentes tuos et terram in qua nata es et veneris ad populum quem ante nesciebas.
pairs.derivation: Ruth's question (v.10), dropping the framing 'dixit ad eum'. Answer is Booz's reply opening (v.11), dropping 'cui ille respondit'. Cut at the full stop ending v.11; the following sentence (v.12 'reddat tibi Dominus pro opere tuo...') turns from answering her 'unde/why' to invoking a blessing, so it is excluded.

pairs.question: Quae es?
pairs.answer: Ego sum Ruth ancilla tua expande pallium tuum super famulam tuam quia propinquus es.
pairs.derivation: Booz asks 'quae es' (v.9), dropping the framing 'et ait illi'. Answer is Ruth's reply, dropping 'illaque respondit'. The whole reply is one run-on utterance with no interior full stop; kept contiguous through the close of v.9, which is the verse boundary and her full self-identifying answer.
